demos.title: Karma to Vitest Migration
demos.teaches: Replace the Karma builder with @angular/build:unit-test, swap jasmine for vitest globals, and rewrite the specs. Covers the httpResource ordering trap: TestBed.tick() before HttpTestingController.flush(), never whenStable() first.

demos.title: Testing Foundations
demos.teaches: Write your first Vitest tests with no TestBed at all: a plain class, two pipes, a service without dependencies, and a component tested through its class. describe/it/expect/beforeEach, value and error assertions.

demos.title: Test Directive
demos.teaches: Test an attribute directive by rendering it on a host component in TestBed and asserting the DOM change it causes. Uses the host object instead of @HostListener.

demos.title: Service HTTP Test
demos.teaches: Test CustomersService CRUD with HttpTestingController. Flush mock responses and verify request URL, method and body for GET, POST, PUT and DELETE.

demos.title: httpResource Test
demos.teaches: Test a component that reads data with httpResource(). Flush the request through HttpTestingController and assert the loading state and the rendered rows.

demos.title: HTTP Error Tests
demos.teaches: Test the failure half of an HTTP call: flush 404, 409, 5xx and a transport error through HttpTestingController, and assert that a functional interceptor maps each status to a readable message and records it.

demos.title: Comp DOM Test
demos.teaches: Read and write the DOM from a spec: type into an input and assert component state, then fire clicks with triggerEventHandler and with the native click API.

demos.title: Input Signals & Outputs
demos.teaches: Set required signal inputs with fixture.componentRef.setInput() on CustomerEditComponent and assert that the save and cancel outputs emit the right values.

demos.title: CRUD Customers
demos.teaches: Test SimpleCustomersComponent, which loads through Angular's resource() API. Spy on CustomersService to control responses and verify the delete and reload path.

demos.title: Comp Spy & Async State
demos.teaches: Replace the signal store with a vi.fn() spy object and steer its signals from the test. Assert store calls and the loading, loaded and selected states without fakeAsync.

demos.title: Test a Signal Form
demos.teaches: Test a Signal Form without the DOM: write field values through field().value.set(), assert required, email, minLength and cross-field errors, then submit() and check touched state, the action result and a server error bound back onto a field.

demos.title: Zoneless Async
demos.teaches: Await asynchronous work in a zoneless app: PendingTasks plus fixture.whenStable(), TestBed.tick() to flush effects and rendering, Vitest fake timers for intervals, and TestBed.getLastFixture() when a helper created the fixture.

demos.title: Container / Presenter
demos.teaches: Integration-test the container with its real presenters. Verify signal inputs flowing down and outputs wiring back up across the whole tree.

demos.title: Test Signal Store
demos.teaches: Test an NgRx SignalStore built from events. Dispatch through the Dispatcher and assert the state transitions for fetch, save, delete and loadContent.

demos.title: Playwright E2E
demos.teaches: Write end-to-end tests with Playwright using the Page Object Model and fixtures. Reset API state between tests, mock the network with page.route, assert on requests and responses, drive the app from the keyboard, group work into test.step with soft assertions, and verify the backend through the API request context.

demos.title: AI Generated Spec
demos.teaches: Prompt the agent to generate a Vitest spec for a branch-heavy class, then review it: mutate the code to prove the tests bite, check boundary values, and reject assertions that only re-state the implementation.

demos.title: AI Writes the Test
demos.teaches: The full loop: state the behaviour, let the agent write the spec with get_best_practices and run_target, review it against a checklist, then run a mutation round that proves the suite goes red when the code breaks.

markdownItems.title: Key Concepts for httpResource Testing
markdownItems.comment: httpResource() uses HttpClient internally so HttpTestingController works the same way

markdownItems.title: Flushing Responses
markdownItems.comment: Call fixture.detectChanges() first to trigger the resource request, then flush with httpMock.expectOne()

comments.title: Using @ngrx/signals
comments.comment: The SignalStore is tested by dispatching events through the Dispatcher.

comments.title: Zoneless change detection
comments.comment: The app is zoneless, so specs use whenStable() and TestBed.tick() instead of fakeAsync.
